description_en: Release an expired Anti-DDoS Proxy instance
description_zh: 释放已经到期的DDoS高防实例
name: ReleaseInstance

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance to be released.

Only expired instances can be released. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91478.html to query the IDs and expiration status of all Anti-DDoS Proxy instances
parameters.help_zh:
要释放的实例ID。

只允许释放已到期的实例。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91478.html查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID和到期状态信息
parameters.name: instance_id

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use it to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
